text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos had gained a bit too much weight 
recently. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Burn calories the fun way with karaoke♪ 
Trainy, Kitasan! Let's get hyped!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"First, a song everyone can get hyped 
to... This one!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Vivlos picked was a popular Western 
song that had also been used in 
commercials.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
!? S-So cool! Is this that "native 
English" thing I've heard about?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe! Thank you! A friend taught me this 
song♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She's aiming for overseas too, you know. 
She said, "I'm gonna travel around the 
world through racing!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So we'd always say, 'If you're aiming for 
the world, you gotta at least be able to 
sing Western songs,' and sing together...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's a song that really gets you fired up! 
Perfect for burning calories, don't you 
think? ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So with that, Trainy! Let's do a duet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Vivlos continued to sing and 
dance to her favorite Western songs—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Singing, dancing, and singing your heart 
out together with your friends—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Burning calories while having fun, they 
successfully lost weight!"
